name: Dizzy Llama
lead: Cold drinks, two pool tables and the big fishbowl drink on North Lasalle. Rated 4.6 stars by 121 Google reviewers.
about: Tracee Weigand opened Dizzy Llama in 2012, after bartending since she was 19. It's a small-town bar, pool hall and sports bar on North Lasalle Street.
There are two pool tables, games on the TV and a big fishbowl drink regulars tell newcomers to try.
services: Full bar, including the big fishbowl drink.
